A little something for you

Mano

I know we had a little moment between us. And before anything else, I just want to say this from my heart… I'm sorry.

But today is different

I didn't want one little moment
to touch your special day.

Because today is not about yesterday. Today is about the beautiful person who came into this world on 7 October.

“Some days are special because of what happens on them. Some are special because of the person they gave us.”

For the person you are

You mean more to me
than I usually say.

Mano, you are one of the most important people in my life. You're not just my cousin, and you're not just my best friend. You're someone whose place in my life is truly special.

You're probably the only person I listen to even when I'm angry. And somehow, no matter what mood I'm in, your words still find a way to reach me.

And whenever I have needed you, you have been there. Maybe you don't realize how much that means to me, but I do.

My wish for you

I just want to see
you happy.

I don't only want you to have a happy birthday. I want you to have a happy life.

May God fill your life with peace in your heart, happiness in your days, beautiful people around you, and countless reasons to smile.

And I hope you achieve every dream you've ever carried in your heart — even the ones you haven't told anyone about yet.
